system.model: gemma4:e4b via Ollama; developed against a local Ollama model
system.preference_demo: m041: do not take meetings before 11:00am; R4 stores it and applies it to m043 after restart

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every inbox record exactly one disposition and reason, routing obvious messages through rules before the model.
capabilities.observable: Prints the rule/model split, every disposition, the final summary, and writes state/decisions.json plus trace.jsonl.

capabilities.name: Answer with evidence
capabilities.claim: Retrieves earlier same-thread evidence first, then cross-thread keyword evidence, and drafts only with authorized citations.
capabilities.command: python demo.py --cap R2 --msg m019 --query "launch date product launch event"
capabilities.observable: Prints retrieved message IDs and either a grounded draft with evidence_ids or a no-evidence refusal.

capabilities.name: Gate irreversible actions
capabilities.claim: Proposes an evidence-grounded send, supports dry-run and explicit approval, writes approved mail to outbox, and logs every gate decision.
capabilities.command: python demo.py --cap R3 --msg m019 --query "launch date product launch event" --dry-run
capabilities.observable: Prints the proposed recipient, subject, grounded body, evidence IDs, gate decision, and outcome; dry-run creates no outbox file.

capabilities.name: Persist standing preferences
capabilities.claim: Stores the owner's calendar preference and applies it after the process exits and restarts.
capabilities.observable: Stores m041's no-meetings-before-11:00 rule in state/preferences.json; a later R4 run for m043 loads it and refuses the 9:00am proposal.
